versions.changelog:
Initial release — discover pre-launch startups and products on Twitter using apidojo’s tweet-scraper.

- Enables users to find early-stage startups, beta products, and stealth companies via advanced Twitter search queries.
- Returns startup handle, product description, launch/waitlist signals, stage classification, and niche.
- Customizable filters: language, verification, media type, engagement thresholds, author/location constraints.
- Includes workflow, scoring logic, output format, troubleshooting, and API/run instructions.
- Ideal for VCs, accelerator scouts, and competitive intelligence teams seeking early signals.
